purpose: OpFin mobile/web sponsored-data and whitelisting boundary

client_whitelist_hosts.purpose: Canonical OpFin API origin used by the Flutter release baseline

explicitly_not_sponsored: Google Play / App Store / AppGallery downloads and updates
Any provider, analytics, CDN or media host not listed in client_whitelist_hosts
server_side_only_integrations: approved lender, insurer, savings, investment and biller providers
rules: A candidate host is not described to customers as sponsored until operator confirmation is configured.
New client-facing hosts require security, privacy, data-budget and MNO-whitelist review before release.
Third-party provider calls should remain server-side unless a separately reviewed client requirement exists.
Whitelisted traffic must not silently redirect to a non-whitelisted host.
